$comment: Rulebook metadata. verifiedDate is stamped when the rule files were last reconciled against sources.
verificationMethod: Each rule was checked against multiple independent sources (official issuance digests, government announcements, and top-tier tax firm alerts) on August 26, 2026, covering the attachments/eAFS rulebook (RMC 49-2020 through RMC 46-2026 line) and the 2026 filing-season one-offs (RMC 20-2026, 30-2026, 39-2026, 46-2026). Values not yet corroborated by at least two independent sources carry confidence: needs_review in the data files, a maintenance flag for the next verification pass.
howToUpdate: All rates, thresholds, deadlines, forms, attachments, and holidays live in src/data/rules/*.json. Change the value, update legalBasis/notes, set confidence, and bump verifiedDate here. No code changes needed. Known future checkpoints: 2027 holiday proclamation (expected Sept–Oct 2026, incl. Dec 24, Nov 2, CNY, Black Saturday, and later the 2027 Eids); each year's SEC MC for the calendar-year AFS date (FY2025's moved May 29 → June 15 mid-season); each year's AITR RMC for season-specific attachment deadlines; EOPT 3-year CPI adjustments of the ₱3M VAT threshold and ₱500 invoice floor (~Jan 2027); pending TY2027 bills on the graduated table and the ₱90k/₱120k bonus cap; the NCR-27 wage-order injunction; each January's alphalist-module release; the RR 11-2025 e-invoicing go-live (first group Dec 31, 2026); the RR 4-2026 micro-taxpayer abatement window (closes Dec 31, 2026).
